test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year did the Rajya Sabha meet for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1952**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Council of States also known as Rajya Sabha meet for the first time on **13 May 1952**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On 23 August 1954**, the Chairman of Rajya Sabha made an announcement in the House that the Council of States would now be called 'Rajya Sabha’ in Hindi.
 
• The Rajya Sabha was first constituted on 3 April 1952.
 
• **Dr. S. Radhakrishnan was the first Chairman** of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• **Shri S.V Krishnamoorthy Rao was the first Deputy Chairman** of Rajya Sabha.
 
• At that time, Two hundred and fifty (250), out of which 238 are to be elected and 12 are to be nominated by the President of India is the maximum strength of Rajya Sabha.
 
• Two hundred and forty-five (245), out of which 233 are elected and 12 are nominated is now the actual strength of Rajya Sabha.
